criteria.requirement: Add Interval.measure(metric, *, start=0): invoke the caller-supplied metric exactly once for each atomic interval in order and combine with addition beginning at start. The metric receives actual bound openness and endpoints so the same protocol can express continuous duration or bounded integer cardinality; no generic endpoint subtraction is implicit. Empty intervals return start without callbacks; preserve Decimal/timedelta result types with an appropriate identity, propagate callback errors and let metrics explicitly reject unbounded domains. Preserve len as the number of atomic pieces, subclasses, laziness of existing APIs and every frozen test.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
